test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements: Some greens are red. All reds are yellow.

Conclusions:

(I) All yellows are greens.

(II) All reds are green.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/677baefc2a095eebf65065927c736f3db9168126c852e1fd70ef6a2747e3cfd6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a23f205de948a312c2710d789d3c98c997266f338fc7ed7869c98866170cc7b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) All yellows are greens → False (as, Some greens are red. All reds are yellow. so, All yellows are greens can be a possibility but not definite)

(II) All reds are green → False (as, Some greens are red. All reds are yellow. so, All reds are greens can be a possibility but not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
